text:
Which statement about homologous series and isomerism is correct?
A
Butane and butene are structural isomers.
B
Compounds in the same homologous series have the same general formula.
C
Compounds in the same homologous series have the same molecular formula.
D
Structural isomers have different molecular formulae.

options.label: A
options.text: Butane and butene are structural isomers.

options.label: B
options.text: Compounds in the same homologous series have the same general formula.

options.label: C
options.text: Compounds in the same homologous series have the same molecular formula.

options.label: D
options.text: Structural isomers have different molecular formulae.
